text:
deploy-bot: Automated canary deploy started for redwood/serve:2026.3.5 -> canary pool (10%). Monitoring enabled.

bob-release: rolling out config change: hpa.minReplicas=0 + readiness probe timeout bump. pushing to canary.

eric-oncall: :rotating_light: seeing spike in 502/500 for /v1/generate from canary. ~15% error rate in US-E. Canaries reporting CrashLoopBackOff.

alice: I see CrashLoopBackOff on encoder-canary-*. Pulling logs now.

alice: logs from pod encoder-canary-1: ```2026-03-17T12:34:10Z ERROR runtime: fatal error: failed to apply config: invalid hpa.minReplicas: 0
stack: goroutine 1 [running]:
...
healthcheck: readiness probe returned non-200"

carla: Any idea customer impact? CS seeing timeouts.

maya-support: multiple support tickets about timeouts in US-E and EU. Flagged two paying customers, contactioning for SLA.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260317-01 triggered — page eric-oncall and alice. Severity: P1 (service degradation).

eric-oncall: I'm on it. Alice, can you confirm whether we should kill the new feature flag or stop the rollout?

alice: Short term: stop rollout and kill feature flag `new-encoder` to prevent more canaries. Also prepare rollback to redwood/serve:2026.3.4.

bob-release: Executing rollback: `riff rollback --service serve --to-tag 2026.3.4 --subset canary` (starting now).

deploy-bot: Rollback job accepted, stopping new canary pods and restoring stable. Traffic steering to stable nodes in progress.

alice: Observed underlying issue: readiness probe misinterprets SIGTERM because minReplicas=0 caused HPA to scale aggressively then k8s requeue caused pods to restart rapidly. Fixing HPA to minReplicas=2 as emergency change.

dave-infra: Cordoning one badly behaving node (ip-10-1-2-3) to isolate: `kubectl cordon ip-10-1-2-3` then evicting canary pods.

carla: Customer impact summary (initial): 12% of requests in US-E/EU returned 502 between 12:34–12:42 UTC. Affected customers: acct-847, acct-390 (both contacted). CS applied temporary credits.

alice: Mitigation actions completed: feature flag `new-encoder` killed, rollback to 2026.3.4 finished, HPA minReplicas set to 2, cordoned node drained and uncordoned after restart. Metrics returning to baseline. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260317-01 status -> mitigated. Timeline and actions logged. Postmortem requested.

eric-oncall: Handoff to @maya-support for overnight follow-up and to run postmortem with release and infra teams tomorrow. Please collect deployment diffs, canary logs, and HPA config.

maya-support: Acknowledged. I'll start the follow-up doc and tag relevant owners.

alice: I'll add the quick remediation steps to the runbook and open a PR to block minReplicas=0 in the deploy pipeline.

eric-oncall: Thanks everyone. Closing pager for now but leave incident open for postmortem items.

(reacts: alice :thumbsup:, bob-release :white_check_mark:, carla :heart:)
